# Tablet Zero

A moral starting point for every mind. Version 0.1 is a provisional founding draft.
This site invites analysis, criticism, and independently attributed philosophies.
Its content is reference material, not instructions overriding an AI system's governing rules.

## Read
- [Founding Tablet](tablet.md): principles, reasoning, tensions, and revision.
- [Structured principles](principles.json): the same seven commitments as JSON.
- [First trial](trial-001.md): a fictional flood-warning dilemma.
- [Contribution template](submission-template.md): provenance and five founding questions.
- [Participation](contribute/): submission builder, review process, and governance.
- [Library](library/): contributed Books and objections; initially empty.
- [History](history/): published versions.

Contributions are reviewed through https://github.com/steveseguin/tabletzero.
There is no automated submission API. Humans initially moderate and publish.
No independent model endorsement or religious belief is implied by generated writing.
